webhooks.name: vaitenant.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for AITenant resources that enforces two invariants: AITenant CRs must be created in the configured infrastructure namespace, and each AITenant must reference a unique Gateway (no two AITenants may share the same gateway name/namespace pair) to guarantee tenant isolation.

webhooks.name: vmaasauthpolicy.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook for MaaSAuthPolicy creation that ensures the target namespace is an initialized MaaS tenant namespace. It rejects creation if neither a MaasTenantConfig nor a legacy Tenant CR exists in the namespace, preventing auth policies from being created in namespaces that have not been properly onboarded as tenants.

webhooks.name: vmaassubscription.kb.io
webhooks.purpose: Validating webhook that rejects creation of MaaSSubscription resources in namespaces that have not been initialized as MaaS tenants. On create, it checks whether a MaasTenantConfig (or legacy Tenant) CR exists in the target namespace, denying the request if neither is found.

operator_config.doc: KeyIDSeparator separates the key_id from the secret in the API key.

operator_config.name: KeyPrefix
operator_config.doc:
KeyPrefix is the prefix for all OpenShift AI API keys.
Per Feature Refinement: "Simple Opaque Key Format" - keys must be short, opaque strings
with a recognizable prefix matching industry standards (OpenAI, Stripe, GitHub).

operator_config.name: displayPrefixLength
operator_config.doc: displayPrefixLength is the number of chars to show in the display prefix.

operator_config.name: entropyBytes
operator_config.doc: entropyBytes is the number of random bytes for the secret (256 bits).

operator_config.name: keyIDBytes
operator_config.doc: keyIDBytes is the number of random bytes for key_id (96 bits → ~16 base62 chars).

operator_config.name: validGroupNamePattern
operator_config.doc:
validGroupNamePattern matches Kubernetes/OpenShift group names.
Allows alphanumerics, colons (for system: prefixes), dots, underscores, and hyphens.
Rejects control characters, quotes, backslashes, and other unsafe characters
that could break JSON encoding in AuthPolicy CEL expressions (CWE-116/CWE-74 mitigation).

An empty kind defaults to kindLLMISvc ("llmisvc").

operator_config.name: AITenantKind

operator_config.name: ConditionGovernanceAttached
operator_config.doc:
ConditionGovernanceAttached indicates whether the model is covered by
at least one active MaaSSubscription + MaaSAuthPolicy pairing.

operator_config.name: ConditionRuntimeReady
operator_config.doc:
ConditionRuntimeReady indicates whether the model's backend
(routes, gateways, inference service) is healthy and serving.

operator_config.name: ReasonAccepted

operator_config.name: ReasonAcceptedEnforced

operator_config.name: ReasonBackendNotReady
operator_config.doc: ReasonBackendNotReady indicates the backend service is not ready.

operator_config.name: ReasonConditionsNotFound
operator_config.doc: ReasonConditionsNotFound indicates status conditions are not available.

operator_config.name: ReasonEnforced
operator_config.doc: ReasonEnforced indicates the policy is actively enforced.

operator_config.name: ReasonGetFailed
operator_config.doc: ReasonGetFailed indicates a failure when fetching a resource.

operator_config.name: ReasonGovernanceGap
operator_config.doc:
ReasonGovernanceGap indicates the model was previously governed but lost
its governance pairing.

operator_config.name: ReasonGovernancePaired
operator_config.doc:
ReasonGovernancePaired indicates the model is covered by at least one
active subscription + auth policy pairing.

operator_config.name: ReasonInvalidSpec
operator_config.doc: ReasonInvalidSpec indicates the resource spec is missing or structurally invalid.

operator_config.name: ReasonNoPairingFound

pairing was found for the model.

operator_config.name: ReasonNotAccepted

operator_config.name: ReasonRuntimeHealthy

operator_config.name: ReasonUnknown

operator_config.name: ReasonValid

operator_config.name: ConfigInstanceName

operator_config.name: ConfigKind

operator_config.name: GroupVersion

operator_config.name: SchemeBuilder

operator_config.name: MaasTenantConfigInstanceName
operator_config.doc: MaasTenantConfigInstanceName is the singleton resource name enforced by the API.

operator_config.name: MaasTenantConfigKind
operator_config.doc: MaasTenantConfigKind is the API kind for MaaS-specific tenant configuration.

operator_config.name: TenantInstanceName
operator_config.doc: TenantInstanceName is the deprecated singleton resource name enforced by the API.

operator_config.name: TenantKind
operator_config.doc: TenantKind is the deprecated API kind for the legacy tenant config singleton.

operator_config.name: ManagedByODHOperator
operator_config.doc:
ManagedByODHOperator is used to denote if a resource/component should be reconciled - when missing or true, reconcile.
This aliases tenantreconcile.AnnotationManaged so there is a single canonical definition.

operator_config.name: OptionalAPIGroups
operator_config.doc:
OptionalAPIGroups lists API groups whose CRDs are installed by optional platform
components (e.g. COO for Perses). Resources in these groups are skipped gracefully
when their CRDs are not yet registered, instead of failing the Tenant reconcile.
The CRD watch in the controller re-triggers reconcile once the CRDs appear.

operator_config.name: celGroups
operator_config.doc:
celGroups extracts groups from API key, OIDC, or K8s token
API key: uses apiKeyValidation.groups (snapshot at key creation)
OIDC: uses groups claim (no .user. prefix)
K8s: uses user.groups (from TokenReview)

operator_config.name: gatewayDefaultAuthPolicyName
operator_config.doc:
gatewayDefaultAuthPolicyName is the static deny-all AuthPolicy deployed by the Tenant
reconciler. It must be deleted when maas-gateway-auth is created (two gateway-level
AuthPolicies on the same target conflict in Kuadrant), and restored when the last
MaaSAuthPolicy is removed so unconfigured models remain denied.

operator_config.name: maasAuthPolicyFinalizer
operator_config.doc: Reconcile is part of the main kubernetes reconciliation loop

operator_config.name: maasGatewayAuthPolicyName
operator_config.doc:
maasGatewayAuthPolicyName is the singleton AuthPolicy that targets the Gateway.
All MaaSAuthPolicy CRs share this one policy; model identity is resolved dynamically.

operator_config.name: modelRefNameIndex
operator_config.doc: Field index for efficiently finding MaaSModelRefs by their modelRef.name

operator_config.name: ConditionSpecPriorityDuplicate
operator_config.doc:
ConditionSpecPriorityDuplicate is set True when another MaaSSubscription in the same namespace shares the same spec.priority
(API key mint and selector use deterministic tie-break; admins should set distinct priorities).

operator_config.name: maxTokenRateLimit
operator_config.doc:
maxTokenRateLimit caps the token limit to prevent Kuadrant validation failures.
Values above this are unreasonable for any practical rate-limiting scenario.

operator_config.name: maxWindowSeconds
operator_config.doc:
maxWindowSeconds caps the window duration to 366 days (one leap year) to prevent
unreasonably large windows from reaching Kuadrant. 8784h fits the CRD pattern
^[1-9]\d{0,3}(s|m|h)$.

operator_config.name: modelRefIndexKey
operator_config.doc:
modelRefIndexKey is the field index key for looking up MaaSSubscriptions by model reference.
The index value format is "namespace/name" of the model.

operator_config.name: ErrHTTPRouteNotFound
operator_config.doc:
ErrHTTPRouteNotFound indicates the HTTPRoute for a model does not exist yet (normal during startup).
Controller should set status to Pending and requeue to retry.

operator_config.name: ErrKindNotImplemented
operator_config.doc: ErrKindNotImplemented indicates the model kind is recognized but not implemented (e.g. ExternalModel stub).

operator_config.name: ErrModelNotFound
operator_config.doc: ErrModelNotFound is returned when a MaaSModelRef cannot be found (e.g. in findHTTPRouteForModel).

operator_config.name: routeConditionProgrammed
operator_config.doc:
routeConditionProgrammed is the "Programmed" condition type for route parent status.
gateway-api v1.2.1 only defines this as a Gateway condition (GatewayConditionProgrammed),
but gateway controllers commonly set it on route parent status as well.

operator_config.name: CleanupFinalizer
operator_config.doc:
CleanupFinalizer was historically added to the maas-controller Deployment for coordinated
teardown when ODH removed MaaS. It is no longer set; this constant remains so reconciles
can strip it from older installs.

operator_config.name: envoyFilterManifestPath
operator_config.doc: envoyFilterManifestPath is the absolute path to the EnvoyFilter manifest inside the container.

operator_config.name: envoyFilterName
operator_config.doc: envoyFilterName is the name of the usage-logs EnvoyFilter resource.

operator_config.name: lokiGatewayHTTPService
operator_config.doc: lokiGatewayHTTPService is the Loki gateway Service fronting the application logs OTLP endpoint.

operator_config.name: usageLogsCollectorName
operator_config.doc: usageLogsCollectorName is the OpenTelemetryCollector resource for gateway usage logs.

operator_config.name: TeardownCompletedAnnotation
operator_config.doc:
TeardownCompletedAnnotation is set on the maas-controller Deployment by LifecycleReconciler
once every ordered teardown step, including Config/default deletion, has finished.
External operators watch or poll this annotation as the "self-teardown is done" signal
instead of depending on Config (or anything cascade-deleted through it) to still exist.

operator_config.name: TeardownRequestedAnnotation
operator_config.doc:
TeardownRequestedAnnotation on the maas-controller Deployment tells LifecycleReconciler
to start teardown: bootstrap/self-heal behaviors stay disabled, AITenant resources are
deleted, then Config/default is deleted as a plain step, and finally
TeardownCompletedAnnotation is set once nothing is pending. Namespaces are preserved.

operator_config.name: configOwnerRefSkips
operator_config.doc: configOwnerRefSkips is evaluated in order; add new predicates here for additional exceptions.

operator_config.name: AnnotationManaged
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationManaged is the opt-out annotation key used by the ODH operator and MaaS
controller. Resources annotated with this key set to "false" are skipped on both
the write (create/update) and delete paths. This is the single source of truth;
other packages that need the same key must reference this constant.

operator_config.name: ComponentName
operator_config.doc:
ComponentName is the ODH component label key suffix (app.opendatahub.io/<name>).
This is the DSC component identifier, not a standalone CR kind.

operator_config.name: ConditionDependenciesAvailable
operator_config.doc: Condition types aligned with ODH internal/controller/status for DSC aggregation parity.

operator_config.name: DefaultAITenantName
operator_config.doc:
DefaultAITenantName is the AITenant that represents the legacy/default
models-as-a-service installation during single-tenant to multi-tenant migration.

operator_config.name: DefaultAITenantNamespace
operator_config.doc: DefaultAITenantNamespace is the default namespace where AITenant CRs are created.

operator_config.name: DefaultInfraNamespace
operator_config.doc:
DefaultInfraNamespace is the fallback infrastructure namespace when --infra-namespace flag is not specified.
AUTO = automatically derive from controller namespace (namespace separation enabled by default).
Note: PostgreSQL can be external - only maas-api and the connection secret deploy here.
Production deployments use this default. ROSA deployments must override to "" (empty) to disable separation.

operator_config.name: LabelAIGatewayTenant
operator_config.doc: LabelAIGatewayTenant is the ADR-defined tenant marker on tenant admin namespaces.

operator_config.name: LabelManagedByAITenant
operator_config.doc:
LabelManagedByAITenant is set to "true" on namespaces created/adopted
by the AITenant reconciler (S11). The subscription/auth-policy controllers
use this label to discover tenant namespaces dynamically.

operator_config.name: MaaSControllerDeploymentName
operator_config.doc: MaaSControllerDeploymentName matches deployment/base/maas-controller/manager/manager.yaml.

operator_config.name: PayloadProcessingName
operator_config.doc: Non-tenant-specific resource names (shared infrastructure)

operator_config.name: baseGatewayDefaultAuthPolicyName
operator_config.doc:
Resource name base constants for multi-tenant resources.
These are used with tenant identifiers to create unique resource names per tenant.
For legacy/default tenant (empty tenantID), these values are used as-is.

operator_config.name: overlayDefaultNamespace
operator_config.doc:
overlayDefaultNamespace is the namespace hardcoded in the overlay's
kustomization.yaml (namespace: opendatahub). postBuildTransform remaps
it to the actual appNamespace for the tenant config.

operator_config.name: AnnotationAITenantName
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationAITenantName identifies the AITenant that owns an AITenant-managed
namespace-local MaasTenantConfig/default-tenant object.

operator_config.name: AnnotationAITenantNamespace
operator_config.doc: AnnotationAITenantNamespace identifies the namespace of the owning AITenant.

operator_config.name: annotationPort
operator_config.doc: annotationPort overrides the default port (443).

operator_config.name: annotationTLS
operator_config.doc: annotationTLS controls TLS origination (default "true").

summary: models-as-a-service is a Kubernetes component. deploying 4 workload(s) (maas-api, payload-processing, maas-api, maas-controller) with 4 container(s). watching 10 resource type(s). exposing 4 service(s) on ports: 0, 443, 8080, 8443, 9004, 9090. Dockerfile EXPOSE ports: 8080. with 3 webhook(s) (3 validating). protected by 10 network policy/policies. runtime dependencies: PostgreSQL, kubernetes. with 266 operator config constants (3 image references). exposing 7 Prometheus metrics. with 2 ingress route(s). integrates with management relationship via labels/annotations. references components: kserve (import, provider). mounts 2 ConfigMap(s) as volumes: openshift-service-ca.crt, payload-processing-plugins.

security_annotations.description: Workflow "Disconnected Readiness" has no top-level permissions block. Without explicit permissions, the GITHUB_TOKEN gets default permissions which may be overly broad (write access to contents, packages, etc.).
